source: The spin law for the electron and other spin-1/2 particles: after a magnet along one axis reads 'up', a magnet at angle t reads 'up' with odds (1 + cos t)/2. Measured with Stern-Gerlach magnets and polarized neutron and electron beams. Range here: plus or minus 0.02. Note: this file holds the measured law with a range, not one lab's raw counts.
